thinChannelDeclaration: ⭐⭐ THE EXAM TESTS THE HONEST (THIN) LEAD CHANNEL, DECLARED AT THE HEAD RATHER THAN DISCOVERED AT THE FOOT (#232.3). In a percept world the passer leads only the mates his OWN EYES carry a remembered velocity for. PTP-T0 measured that channel: 921 of 1,109 support projections were exactly ZERO in the percept world (mean remembered speed 0.717 m/s against truth's 2.513), and 21.7 % of chosen passes carried a lead against 62.9 % bare. So the DELIVERED lead here is expected around ONE THIRD of a bare world's, and that degradation IS the design (contract §7(a)) — the world is not chosen for the lead's convenience, it is chosen because OBM's four-limb arming requires it and because it is the cell the #230 signal came from. Every arm publishes its DELIVERED LEAD so the thin channel stays visible instead of being assumed away.

The matrix is the DOSE; what the executor actually consumes is the composed PLANE, whose size is the mean of the WEIGHTED FEATURES — and the features are small on average (#228.6: f1 0.184 · f2 0.456 · f3 0.216 · f4 0.171). The four support-tick classes partition exactly: SHIFTED · PLANE-ZERO · PLANE-ABSENT (no decision inside OBM_POLICY_TTL_TICKS — the cadence cap) · UNSHIFTED-CLAMP-BOUND (the INCUMBENT pitch clamp pinned both pre-clamp values to the same bound). ⭐ READ PLANE-ZERO CAREFULLY: it has THREE causes, and only one of them is blindness — (i) this arm doses no plane row at all (a SCORE-only corner moves no geometry BY CONSTRUCTION); (ii) this arm's own driving features read zero at that moment (for an f1 corner: the carrier is not perceived-pressed — the CONCENTRATION the hypothesis is about); (iii) genuine silence — nothing this body reads is non-zero — which the delivered-dose read BOUNDS FROM ABOVE as `allFeaturesZeroShare` (~1 % of samples; a ceiling, not a measurement, because four zero features also occur with opponents PRESENT beyond the feature radii). None of the four classes is slop and none of them is a gate on its own.
